<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_ord_ops_aias.orderExceptionCheckDemo</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Implements extension point sn_ord_ops_aias.orderExceptionCheckEP
This is a demo implementation for order exception checks including delivery availability validation, quantity changes, and shipping location changes for order line items</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>orderExceptionCheckDemo</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var AVAILABLE_PROD_OFFERINGS_LIST = [
    "acc007313b838f10d5260fa693e45a53", // Spark Plug
	"206007fd3b438f10d5260fa693e45a74", // Automatic Voltage Regulator
	"eccb69042bcbc7104deaf02ac891bff0", // Solana Conference 1-Day Pass
    "fccba9042bcbc7104deaf02ac891bf34" // Solana Conference 3-Day Pass
];

var MAX_ALLOWED_QTY = 1000;
var DEMO_LOCATION_ID = "25aba4010a0a0bb3008f329002f12211"; // cmn_location sys_id for 20220 Bow Willow, Houston,TX

var orderExceptionCheckDemo = Class.create();
orderExceptionCheckDemo.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
        this.DEMO_LOCATION_ID = DEMO_LOCATION_ID;
        this._availableOfferingsMap = {};
        for (var i = 0; i < AVAILABLE_PROD_OFFERINGS_LIST.length; i++) {
            this._availableOfferingsMap[AVAILABLE_PROD_OFFERINGS_LIST[i]] = true;
        }
        this.MAX_ALLOWED_QTY = MAX_ALLOWED_QTY;
    },

    canHandle: function() {
        return true;
    },

    _buildOfferingsMap: function() {
        var map = {};
        for (var i = 0; i < AVAILABLE_PROD_OFFERINGS_LIST.length; i++) {
            map[AVAILABLE_PROD_OFFERINGS_LIST[i]] = true;
        }
        return map;
    },

    /**
     * Checks expedite availability for order line items.
     * @param {Object} lines - Keyed by line sys_id: { "<sys_id>": { line_number, product_offering, quantity, expected_date, location } }
     * @param {string} requestedDate - Requested delivery date (yyyy-MM-dd)
     * @returns {Object} { canExpedite: boolean, isError: boolean, errorMsg: string, proposedDate: string }
     */
    getAvailability: function(lines, requestedDate) {
        var availableOfferingsMap = this._buildOfferingsMap();
        var answer = {
            canExpedite: false,
            isError: false,
            errorMsg: "",
            proposedDate: ""
        };

        if (!lines || Object.keys(lines).length === 0) {
            answer.isError = true;
            answer.errorMsg = gs.getMessage("No line items provided");
            return answer;
        }

        if (gs.nil(requestedDate)) {
            answer.isError = true;
            answer.errorMsg = gs.getMessage("No requested date provided");
            return answer;
        }

        var requestedGdt = new GlideDateTime(requestedDate);
        if (!requestedGdt.isValid()) {
            answer.isError = true;
            answer.errorMsg = gs.getMessage("Invalid requested date: {0}", requestedDate);
            return answer;
        }

        var lineIds = Object.keys(lines);

        for (var k = 0; k < lineIds.length; k++) {
            var checkLine = lines[lineIds[k]];
            if (!checkLine || availableOfferingsMap[checkLine.product_offering] !== true) {
                answer.canExpedite = false;
                answer.errorMsg = gs.getMessage("Cannot expedite: one or more line items are not eligible for expedited delivery");
                return answer;
            }
        }

        var today = new GlideDateTime();
        var oneMonthAfterToday = new GlideDateTime(today);
        oneMonthAfterToday.addMonthsLocalTime(1);

        var canExpedite = true;
        var latestEarliestGdt = null;

        for (var i = 0; i < lineIds.length; i++) {
            var line = lines[lineIds[i]];
            var earliestDate = this._calculateEarliestDeliveryFromDate(line.expected_date, today, oneMonthAfterToday);

            if (!gs.nil(earliestDate)) {
                var earliestGdt = new GlideDateTime(earliestDate);
                var canExpediteThisLine = !requestedGdt.before(earliestGdt);

                if (latestEarliestGdt === null || earliestGdt.after(latestEarliestGdt)) {
                    latestEarliestGdt = new GlideDateTime(earliestGdt);
                }

                if (!canExpediteThisLine) {
                    canExpedite = false;
                }
            } else {
                canExpedite = false;
            }
        }

        if (latestEarliestGdt !== null) {
            answer.proposedDate = latestEarliestGdt.getDate().toString();
        }

        answer.canExpedite = canExpedite;

        return answer;
    },

    /**
     * Calculates the earliest delivery date from a given expected date.
     * @param {string} expectedDate - The expected delivery/start date (pre-fetched)
     * @param {GlideDateTime} today - Pre-computed current date
     * @param {GlideDateTime} oneMonthAfterToday - Pre-computed today + 1 month
     * @returns {string} Formatted earliest delivery date, or empty string on failure
     */
    _calculateEarliestDeliveryFromDate: function(expectedDate, today, oneMonthAfterToday) {
        if (!expectedDate) {
            return oneMonthAfterToday.getDate().toString();
        }

        var expectedGdt = new GlideDateTime(expectedDate);
        if (!expectedGdt.isValid()) {
            return oneMonthAfterToday.getDate().toString();
        }

        var oneMonthBeforeExpected = new GlideDateTime(expectedGdt);
        oneMonthBeforeExpected.addMonthsLocalTime(-1);

        var earliestDeliveryDate = oneMonthBeforeExpected.after(oneMonthAfterToday) ? oneMonthBeforeExpected : oneMonthAfterToday;

        return earliestDeliveryDate.getDate().toString();
    },

    /**
     * Checks if an order line item quantity can be increased.
     * Allowed only when every line product offering is a demo product offering AND the request qty is >0 & different from ordered quantity
     *
     * @param {Object.<string, {product_offering: string}>} lines - Map of order line
     *        items keyed by line sys_id
     * @example
     * lines = {
     *     "sys_id1": { product_offering: "sys_id" },
     *     "sys_id2": { product_offering: "sys_id" }
     * };
     * @param {number} requestedQty - The requested new quantity
     * @returns {Object} Result with approvedQty : number, canChangeQty : boolean, isError : boolean, errorMsg : string
     */
    checkOrderQuantity: function(orderLines, requestedQty) {
        var availableOfferingsMap = this._buildOfferingsMap();
        var answer = {
            approvedQty: 0,
            canChangeQty: false,
            isError: false,
            errorMsg: ""
        };

        if (gs.nil(orderLines)) {
            answer.isError = true;
            answer.errorMsg = "orderLines is required";
            return answer;
        }

        var qty = parseFloat(requestedQty);
        if (!qty || qty <= 0) {
            answer.isError = true;
            answer.errorMsg = "Requested qty is required, please provide value greater than 0";
            return answer;
        }

        var lineIds = Object.keys(orderLines);
        if (lineIds.length === 0) {
            answer.isError = true;
            answer.errorMsg = "orderLines is empty.";
            return answer;
        }
        for (var i = 0; i < lineIds.length; i++) {
            var line = orderLines[lineIds[i]];
            if (!line || !line.product_offering) {
                answer.isError = true;
                answer.errorMsg = "Line '" + lineIds[i] + "' is missing product_offering.";
                return answer;
            }

            if (!availableOfferingsMap[line.product_offering]) {
                answer.isError = true;
                answer.errorMsg = "Product offering is not eligible for quantity change.";
                return answer;
            }
        }

        if (qty > MAX_ALLOWED_QTY) {
            answer.approvedQty = MAX_ALLOWED_QTY;
            answer.canChangeQty = true;
        } else {
            answer.approvedQty = qty;
            answer.canChangeQty = true;
        }
        return answer;
    },

    /**
     * Checks if the shipping location can be changed for the given order line items.
     *
     * Allowed only when every line is a demo product offering AND the requested
     * location differs from the configured demo location.
     *
     * @param {Object.<string, {product_offering: string}>} lines - Map of order line
     *        items keyed by line sys_id
     * @example
     * lines = {
     *     "sys_id1": { product_offering: "sys_id" },
     *     "sys_id2": { product_offering: "sys_id" }
     * };
     * @param {string} requestedShippingLoc - sys_id of the requested shipping location.
     *
     * @returns {{canChangeLocation: boolean, isError: boolean, errorMsg: string}} Result of the validation.
     */
    checkShippingLocationChange: function(orderLines, requestedShippingLoc) {
        var availableOfferingsMap = this._buildOfferingsMap();
        var answer = {
            canChangeLocation: false,
            isError: false,
            errorMsg: ""
        };

        if (gs.nil(orderLines)) {
            answer.isError = true;
            answer.errorMsg = "orderLines is required.";
            return answer;
        }

        if (!requestedShippingLoc) {
            answer.isError = true;
            answer.errorMsg = "requestedShippingLoc is required.";
            return answer;
        }

        var lineIds = Object.keys(orderLines);
        if (lineIds.length === 0) {
            answer.isError = true;
            answer.errorMsg = "orderLines is empty.";
            return answer;
        }

        for (var i = 0; i < lineIds.length; i++) {
            var line = orderLines[lineIds[i]];
            if (!line || !line.product_offering) {
                answer.isError = true;
                answer.errorMsg = "Line '" + lineIds[i] + "' is missing product_offering.";
                return answer;
            }
            if (!availableOfferingsMap[line.product_offering]) {
                return answer;
            }
        }

        if (DEMO_LOCATION_ID != requestedShippingLoc) {
            answer.canChangeLocation = true;
        }
        return answer;
    },

    /**
     * Runs exception checks on selected order line items, evaluating which requested
     * changes (quantity, shipping location, expedition date) are permitted.
     *
     * @param {Object} payload - Map keyed by selected line number, each entry with
     *        `lines` (map by line sys_id) and `requested_changes`.
     *
     * @returns {Object} Map keyed by selected line number with flat per-line results.
     *
     * @example
     * // Input
     * payload = {
     *   "selectedLineNumber1": {
     *     lines: { "sys_id1": { product_offering: "sys_id" } },
     *     requested_changes: { requested_quantity: 10, requested_shipping_location: "loc_id", requested_expected_date: "2024-12-31" }
     *   }
     * }
     *
     * // Output
     * {
     *   "selectedLineNumber1": {
     *     canChangeQty: true, approvedQty: 10, isQuantityError: false, quantityErrorMsg: "",
     *     canChangeLocation: false, isLocationError: false, locationErrorMsg: "",
     *     canExpedite: true, earliestDelivery: "2024-12-31", isDateError: false, dateErrorMsg: ""
     *   }
     * }
     */
    checkOrderExceptionReq: function(payload) {
        var res = {};

        if (!payload || typeof payload !== "object") {
            return {
                isError: true,
                errorMsg: gs.getMessage("Invalid or missing payload")
            };
        }
        var self = this;
        Object.keys(payload).forEach(function(selectedLineNumber) {
            var selectedItem = payload[selectedLineNumber] || {};
            var requestedChanges = selectedItem.requested_changes || {};
            var lines = selectedItem.lines || {};

            var lineResult = {};

            if (!gs.nil(requestedChanges.requested_quantity)) {
                var qtyRes = self.checkOrderQuantity.call(self, lines, requestedChanges.requested_quantity) || {};
                lineResult.canChangeQty = qtyRes.canChangeQty;
                lineResult.isQuantityError = qtyRes.isError;
                lineResult.quantityErrorMsg = qtyRes.errorMsg;
                lineResult.approvedQty = qtyRes.approvedQty;
            }

            if (!gs.nil(requestedChanges.requested_shipping_location)) {
                var locRes = self.checkShippingLocationChange.call(self, lines, requestedChanges.requested_shipping_location) || {};
                lineResult.canChangeLocation = locRes.canChangeLocation;
                lineResult.isLocationError = locRes.isError;
                lineResult.locationErrorMsg = locRes.errorMsg;
            }

            if (!gs.nil(requestedChanges.requested_expected_date)) {
                var expeditionRes = self.getAvailability.call(self, lines, requestedChanges.requested_expected_date) || {};
                lineResult.canExpedite = expeditionRes.canExpedite;
                lineResult.earliestDelivery = expeditionRes.proposedDate;
                lineResult.isDateError = expeditionRes.isError;
                lineResult.dateErrorMsg = expeditionRes.errorMsg;
            }

            res[selectedLineNumber] = lineResult;
        });

        return res;
    },

    type: 'orderExceptionCheckDemo'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-09-30 12:48:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>13a2bbadfb987210e124fe7405efdc26</sys_id><sys_mod_count>66</sys_mod_count><sys_name>orderExceptionCheckDemo</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Manage Order Operations" source="sn_ord_ops_aias">d7e35570ff84b210d6e6ffffffffff82</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Manage Order Operations">d7e35570ff84b210d6e6ffffffffff82</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_13a2bbadfb987210e124fe7405efdc26</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>alefiyah.balasinorwa@snc</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-01 18:31:48</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>CustomerPortalCatalogAccessUtil</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var CustomerPortalCatalogAccessUtil = Class.create();
CustomerPortalCatalogAccessUtil.prototype = {

    canShowCatalogMenuItem: function() {

            return false;
        }

        if (!user.getCompanyID()) {

        }

        //     if (user.hasRole(excludedRoles[i])) {
        //         return false;
